source_documents.title: Non-adiabatic quantum dynamics of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons exhibiting anti-Kasha emission from the S2 state

reference_evidence_units.quote: All MCTDH dynamics were run at 0 K
reference_evidence_units.subject: Four PAHs including the target
reference_evidence_units.conditions: LVC/MCTDH initial vibrational ground state; B3LYP/TZP gradients and Hessians with ADC(2)/def2TZVP excitation-energy corrections.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The study uses reduced-mode quantum dynamics after initial S1 or S2 population, not new experimental fluorescence or aggregation measurements.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The 0 K refers to the initial vibrational state; conclusions concern an ultrafast simulated window. SI parameters were not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The oscillator strength for the transition to the bright state S2 (0.3834) is an order of magnitude higher
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3,4-benzopyrene
reference_evidence_units.conditions: ADC(2)/def2TZVP vertical states at B3LYP/TZP ground-state geometry.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The computed S2 oscillator strength is 0.3834 versus 0.0320 for S1, with a 0.115 eV gap; S3 lies about 0.84 eV above S2.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The states are delocalized pi-pi* excitations rather than an established donor-acceptor CT pair; vertical properties do not equal emission rates.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 85% of the exciton population has relaxed to S1.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3,4-benzopyrene
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Gas-phase MCTDH following initial S2 excitation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: At 200 fs approximately 85% has reached S1; early S2-to-S1 transfer fits approximately 70 fs and later populations oscillate near 70% S1/30% S2 over 200 fs-3 ps.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Computed populations, not direct measurements. The paper notes the lack of target-specific experimental decay data; its pyrene comparison is a comparator, not target validation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the populations of S1 and S2 oscillate around 90% and 10%, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3,4-benzopyrene
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Initial S1 excitation, gas-phase 3 ps model.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Uphill transfer creates a small sustained S2 population even when the nominally dark S1 is initially occupied.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The initial S1 and S2 conditions produce different average populations, not one universal thermodynamic equilibrium.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This dynamic equilibrium between the S1 and S2 states results in a steady population of S2
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3,4-benzopyrene
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Interpretation of early-time simulations and previously reported fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors propose vibronically sustained S2 population as the basis for spontaneous S2-to-S0 anti-Kasha fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The simulations are much shorter than the reported emission lifetime scale; extrapolation to longer times relies on earlier literature, not direct simulation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the simulations starting from either S1 and S2 yield identical kinetics with almost equal average populations
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3,4-benzopyrene, modified model
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Artificially reduce S1-S2 gap to 25% of the original, 0.029 eV; 100-1500 fs.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors' sensitivity calculation approaches equal S1/S2 populations at the smallest imposed gap, supporting the importance of gap size.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is an artificial Hamiltonian control, not a measured or chemically synthesized lower-gap target.

reference_evidence_units.quote: does not significantly disrupt the dynamic equilibrium between the S1 and S2 states.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3,4-benzopyrene, modified mode sets
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Turn off six low-, mid-, or high-energy modes in separate model calculations; Fig.9 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The remaining modes compensate qualitatively, retaining coupled-state dynamics although oscillation amplitudes and periods change.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Mode deletion is not experimental restriction of intramolecular motion and must not be converted into an AIE/RIM claim.

reference_evidence_units.quote: oscillate around 50% throughout the entire simulation window
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3,4-benzopyrene in modeled MeCN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: COSMO acetonitrile correction, compared with gas-phase model.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source reports a more nearly balanced S1/S2 population in the solvent model for either initial state.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This result is reported in main text with Fig.S6; SI was not inspected. No physical host confinement or PET is demonstrated.

reference_evidence_units.quote: fails to predict the correct dimensionality of the conical intersection seams.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ADC(2) methodology
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors acknowledge ADC(2)'s CI-topology limitation; their reduced LVC dynamics should not be treated as a definitive CI-access map.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No target-specific ground-state CI decay or aggregation-induced CI restriction is established.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The explicit mechanism is redistribution between a relatively dark S1 and brighter S2 through small-gap vibronic coupling. Populations are simulated and depend on the initial state and model assumptions.

reference_mechanisms.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source assigns S2-to-S0 anti-Kasha emission maintained by S1/S2 exchange; the present work simulates early-time populations rather than measuring or propagating radiative emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific suppression of internal rotations or vibrations is established by the selected evidence; rigidity or emission enhancement alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The selected source does not establish a target packing, host or matrix confinement mechanism.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No discrete host-guest binding or inclusion mechanism is established; solvent polarity or packing alone does not establish this family.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific ICT/TICT emissive-state assignment is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific excited-state proton-transfer pathway is reported in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific photoinduced electron-transfer pathway is established; orbital transitions alone are insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregation or close contacts do not by themselves establish an aggregate exciton, excimer, exciplex, or H/J excited state.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The explicit mechanism is redistribution between a relatively dark S1 and brighter S2 through small-gap vibronic coupling. Populations are simulated and depend on the initial state and model assumptions.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No triplet, metal-mediated, or energy-transfer explanation is established for this target by the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Diabatic MECP-based mode selection and coupled-state dynamics do not independently establish a CI-mediated emission/quenching mechanism; ADC(2) CI topology is explicitly limited.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The source assigns S2-to-S0 anti-Kasha emission maintained by S1/S2 exchange; the present work simulates early-time populations rather than measuring or propagating radiative emission.

structure_verification.problem: wrong molecule (picene C22H14 instead of benzo[a]pyrene C20H12)
structure_verification.basis: PubChem for the paper's name (benzo[a]pyrene); atom and mode count in the paper
evidence: case SMILES is picene, C22H14 (36 atoms)
paper: '3,4-Benzopyrene is a symmetric molecule (Cs symmetry) with 32 atoms and 90 normal modes' = benzo[a]pyrene C20H12
